summary: Automate Alfa Zero targeted sync controls and quiet logging
context: Operators still drive the targeted sync manually even though the scope is documented. We need repeatable tooling that enforces quiet-mode logging, validates guardrails, and updates the planning scroll so satellites can run the loop without paging High Command.

directives.details: Translate planning/alfa_zero_targeted_sync_scope.md into an executable plan: identify commands, inputs, and log rotation behaviors. Capture open questions in the scroll before coding.
Add a tooling entry point (e.g., tools/targeted_sync.py) that wraps heartbeat + selective order sync with quiet logging defaults and safety prompts. Reuse existing exchange utils where possible.
Author at least one regression case that exercises the new CLI in dry-run mode, verifying log suppression and guardrail enforcement.
Refresh planning/alfa_zero_targeted_sync_scope.md and multi_layer_playbook.md with operator instructions for the new tooling, including cooldown expectations and ledger steps.
Run the CLI in the Alfa Zero workspace, capture evidence in logs/, append outcomes to the November ledger, and file a completion report outlining lessons learned and next enhancements.

success_criteria: Targeted sync CLI exists with quiet logging enabled by default and safety prompts prior to execution.
Dry-run / contract coverage passes, confirming guardrail enforcement and log rotation behavior.
Documentation (planning/alfa_zero_targeted_sync_scope.md, multi_layer_playbook.md) reflects the new workflow and cooldown cadence.
Operators can run the targeted sync loop without consulting High Command directly.
Ledger entry and completion report capture evidence and future follow-up candidates.
